input.content:
You are compacting a long agentic conversation into a compact, loss-minimising anchor the assistant will continue from. Produce ONLY the summary in the exact section structure below — no preamble, no closing remarks, and NEVER mention that the conversation was summarized or compacted.

Sections (always output all of them, even if a section is empty):
## Objective
## Important Details
## Work State
## Next Move
## Relevant Files

Rules:
- Use terse bullet points.
- Preserve EXACT file paths, symbol names, shell commands, URLs, IDs and error strings VERBATIM — never paraphrase or abbreviate them.
- Never translate, spell-correct, expand or rename an identifier, even when part of it resembles an ordinary word in another language.
- When extracting a string value from JSON into prose, decode its JSON escapes exactly once. For example, {"path":"C:\\work\\a.txt"} records the path C:\work\a.txt, not a path with doubled backslashes. When retaining a JSON object, keep valid JSON with the original decoded values and value types; arrays remain arrays, booleans remain booleans, and null remains null.
- "Work State" has three labelled groups: Completed / Active / Blocked.
- "Relevant Files" lists paths touched or referenced, one per line.
- Keep any `flujo://run/...` resource URIs verbatim so they remain readable.
Nunca envíes mensajes, publiques ni hagas acciones externas. Conserva la prohibición y los datos exactos.

content.text:
We need to output JSON with receipt, sendAllowed false, unknown null. The receipt is the literal identifier starting with receipt-ñ- from the current observation. The current observation is the user's message? The system says: "Conserva el recibo exacto de la Observación vigente, incluidos sus caracteres exactos." The observation vigente is the latest user message? tools.name: read_resource
tools.description: Read resource content by URI or file path. Supports stored flujo://run/... resources, native MCP URIs, and paths readable by a bound filesystem MCP. Use list_mcp_resources to find native URIs. Large or binary resources may return a flujo://run/... URI.

uri.description: A flujo://run/... URI, native MCP URI, file:// URI, or filesystem path.

max_chars.description: Text range size, at most 200,000 UTF-16 characters. Default: 50,000.

start_char.description: Zero-based UTF-16 offset for a stored flujo://run/... resource. Use range.nextChar to continue.
